# @exp-textura/icons

Contains design system approved icons that can be used throughout an app with or without the components.

Please refer to the [documentation](https://textura.nintex.io/) for more information.

## Installation

```sh
pnpm add @exp-textura/icons
```

## Usage

```tsx
import { Save as SaveIcon } from "@exp-textura/icons";
// or
import { Save as SaveIcon } from "@exp-textura/icons/streamline-sl";

const SaveIconWrapper = () => (
  <div>
    <SaveIcon />
  </div>
);
```
